notes.title: Ahros New Year update
notes.notes:
Today we release an update that will add a lot of cool new features to the game and bring a New Year spirit.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26319253/82366e50d05f8896e8bab22a5b4a7e6fb4bf3af9.jpg[/img]

Main update features:

 - New weapons. Now you have a wide range of weapons and shooting mechanics to play with.
 - New location. Big location with shooting ranges and trainers to practice before going into the real combat.
 - New NPC. A beautiful girl with quality animations and interactive features.
 - New Year decorations, to bring a holiday mood.

We hope you will have a lot of fun playing Ahros: One Warrior Chronicle. We're looking forward to seeing your feedback.
